scope_of_deliverables.value: The Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is seeking proposals for a review of the training cascade model for delivering effective capacity strengthening to BCI farmers. The project involves an online survey of 60 Programme Partners across 11 countries, analysis of results, and follow-up consultations.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: We are seeking proposals from skilled individuals or organisations interested in supporting BCI in their review of the training cascade model for delivering effective capacity strengthening to BCI farmers to facilitate the adoption of improved farming practices.

evaluation_criteria.quote: Technical Evaluation Criteria: Demonstrated understanding of this RFP; Quality and clarity of the proposed approach and methodology; Feasibility of the proposed activity plan and timeline, and appropriateness of time allocated to delivering each task; Relevant professional experience of the proposed consultant(s); Quality and relevance of the sample work submitted. Financial Evaluation Criteria: Quality and clarity of budget provided, and level of detail included; Alignment of the budget to the activity timeline detailed in the technical proposal; Value for money; Adherence to the available budget.

pricing_structure.value: Proposals should include a detailed and transparent budget in EUROS, including time allocation and day rates. Financial evaluation criteria include quality and clarity of budget, alignment to timeline, value for money, and adherence to budget.
